keyFindings.description: CoreSubOK reads only Subscription.IsValid, which nats.go v1.50.0 never clears on a server's permission refusal (processTransientError sets the unexported permissionsErr, nats.go:3806-3833; IsValid checks only conn and closed, :4928-4934). After a reconnect onto a server that refuses notifications.>, the live lane delivers nothing while /healthz answers 200 healthy, live_topics: subscribed (cmd/listener/main.go:371). Reproduced by the deep review on the built listener at 5bdf1607 ($TMPDIR/deep-review-live-*/listener.log: 'envoy nats async error name=envoy-live-topics ... Permissions Violation for Subscription to notifications.>' after reconnect, then a publish returned 200 and no prompt). The startup Flush+LastError check (main.go:551-558) runs only at start. Fix: the refusal of the current core subscription makes CoreSubOK false (or ends the listener) until a subscription the server accepts; a regression test restarts the server without the grant.

The PR adds a refusal at a process boundary (POST /v1/interests/subscribe answers 400 for a serving-port registration whose host is not an IP literal or plain host name; config.Load refuses any ENVOY_SUBSCRIBE_ALL_TOPICS other than unset/''/0/1) and its body carries no ## Contract change census. The census must list the search commands and every sender with a disposition, notably packages/envoy-client/src/transport.ts:320 (host: machineID() = ENVOY_MACHINE_ID || os.hostname()), which the OpenCode plugin sends with a port: an ENVOY_MACHINE_ID holding a space now gets every registration refused, including on a compose host whose ENVOY_HOST_BRIDGE would win over the host anyway; and a rollout line (warn-first, or an immediate refusal naming the vulnerability it closes).

'it reaches every session subscribed to it when it is published, the publisher included' is false for a serve-port publisher: fanoutDelivery skips the source session (cmd/listener/delivery.go:670-679 'listener skip echo', which the tester also observed). The tool description and skills/envoy/SKILL.md attach 'yours included' to own-NATS sessions only; this row should say the same.
